notes.title: 《Blessing Part I》1.0.03 version
notes.notes:
1. XBOX controllers are now fully supported!

The XBOX controller can currently fully play this game and is compatible with the corresponding UI.

2. Adjustment of energy system.

Weakened the energy recovery speed of both difficulty levels of 'suffering/despair'.

3. Partial display missing fixes.

When using the 'Emergency Reply' (herb is 0), a prompt will be given if the sword power is insufficient.
Urgent response: We need more than half of our energy to use it now.

4. Improved the sword power consumed by strengthening sword skills.
5. Several minor bugs and adjustments to details.

More optimizations are underway!
Thank you all for playing this game.

notes.title: 《Blessing Part I》1.0.02 version
notes.notes:
1. Add the 'Energy' system.

[Flash] and [Engage/Block] no longer consume sword power, but rather energy.
Energy will recover over time, and using herbs can restore full energy.
When the energy is too low, it is impossible to use [Flash] or [Engage/Block].

2. Key position adjustment.

Many players have given feedback that the current key position is unreasonable and the operation is very awkward, so they have made the following changes:

[Flash]: [Original] Left Shift or S key ->[Now] Space bar or left Shift key
[Jump]: [Original] Space bar ->[Now] W key
[Engage/Block]: [Original] W key ->[Now] S key

Apologies to players who have adapted to the old key positions! I hope the new keys can provide better gameplay.

There are still two key options to choose from now. You can switch in the [Key Description] column of the [ESC] menu.

Option A: Default button scheme.
Option B: Exchange of [Style] and [Engage/Block].

3. Improved the efficiency of obtaining sword power.
4. Fixed some other minor bugs.

More optimizations are underway!
Thank you all for playing this game.

notes.title: 《Blessing Part I》1.0.01 version
notes.notes:
There are currently two key options to choose from. You can switch in the [Key Description] column of the [ESC] menu.

Option A: The default button scheme for "Blessing Part I".
Option B: Swap [Style] and [Engage/Block], now the right mouse button is [Engage/Block], and the W key is related to [Style].

2. Changed the position of teaching related to 'Engage/Block'.
3. Improved the returns of 'Perfect Engage' and 'Perfect Insight', now able to gain more sword power.
4. Fixed some enemy turning issues.
5. Now you can also return to the main menu on the chapter selection and difficulty selection pages.

More optimizations are underway!
Thank you all for playing this game. If you encounter any problems, please provide feedback directly in this comment!

notes.title: Raise your sword and venture into the unknown darkness
notes.notes:
Pixel Board Action Adventure Game - "Blessing Part I" has been officially released!

During the gameplay, if you have any thoughts or suggestions, please feel free to discuss them in the community!
If you defeat the strong enemies one by one, complete the game until the end, and think the game is good, please leave a recommendation for the game. Thank you for your support!

Wishing you a pleasant trip!
